feedback:
Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Unapproved external/generated IRI(s):  "2007-07-01"^^xsd:date &&
        ?summer 
Semantic validator feedback: Repair deterministic vocabulary validation and applicability. The shape currently targets every nltl:ship, but TRF-014 is ice-class applicability: target ships having nltl:iceClass (for example, sh:targetSubjectsOf nltl:iceClass while retaining a ship-class check), using the already supplied canonical term. Prevent accidental pass when marking applicability cannot be evaluated by requiring constructionDate, summerLoadLineFreshWaterDraught, and upperIceWaterlineDraught with sh:minCount 1 and their existing datatype/quantity constraints; keep firstScheduledDryDockingDate conditionally required only for the pre-2007 branch. Rewrite the pre-2007 SPARQL comparisons so the deterministic extractor cannot interpret text between '<' and a later '>' as an IRI, e.g. express built-before as FILTER(!(?built >= "2007-07-01"^^xsd:date)) and dock-not-later-than-today as FILTER(!(?dock > ?today)). Then rerun deterministic validation; it must report valid=true before freezing.

Reverse and tighten both marking comparisons: the obligation applies only when the summer fresh-water draught is strictly greater than the UIWL draught, so replace FILTER(!(?summer >= ?uiwl)) with FILTER(?summer > ?uiwl). For pre-1-July-2007 ships, validate and use the first scheduled dry-docking date strictly after 2007-07-01; an arbitrary earlier date must not satisfy the date-readiness check or bypass the marking deadline. Add maxCount 1 to the determining dates, draught quantities, and boolean status properties to prevent contradictory multiple values from accidentally passing.

query_feedback: Remove the unconditional pre-2007 dry-docking constraint: it incorrectly requires every pre-1 July 2007 ship to provide a qualifying docking date even when the draught condition is false or the required markings are already present. Encode the old-ship branch so that, only when summer fresh-water draught exceeds UIWL and either marking is absent, the ship must have a first scheduled dry-docking date after 1 July 2007 that has not yet passed; otherwise report the missing markings after the deadline. Also represent and validate that the ice-class draught mark is positioned at the maximum permissible ice-class draught amidships, rather than checking presence alone; locate the canonical property for that mark value/position via the variable matcher.

feedback_appendix: Use this exact term because it represents the amidships draught as a QUDT QuantityValue measured in metres, fitting the required value/position of the ice-class draught mark at the maximum permissible ice-class draught amidships.
